name: nestjs-cls-root
description: A continuation-local storage module compatible with NestJS's dependency injection.
author: papooch

scripts.test: node test/with-test-dbs.mjs yarn workspaces foreach --all --parallel --jobs 4 --exclude nestjs-cls-root run test --maxWorkers=4
scripts.build: yarn workspaces foreach --all --topological-dev --exclude nestjs-cls-docs run build
scripts.build:release: yarn workspaces foreach --all --topological-dev --exclude nestjs-cls-docs run build:release
scripts.depcruise: yarn depcruise packages --include-only "^packages/.*/src" --exclude "\.spec\.ts" --config --output-type dot | dot -T svg | yarn depcruise-wrap-stream-in-html > dependency-graph.html
